name: Bear Witness, the Death of the Gods
description:
'An instant later, the constituent matter will still exist, but the intrinsic nature of truth shall die, drowned in the madness of darkness. Countless civilizations have vanished, and the ripples they leave behind continue to fall, crushing, burying, and destroying everything.'
<Intrusive Call> PRTS deploys enemies and Weakening Nodes, and activates Weakening Nodes.
<Weakening Node> Reduces opposing forces' DEF and RES after activation.
